title: Testing
description: Unit-test ideas expressed as small stdout-checked programs (adapted for this platform).
theory:
> **Curriculum:** This chapter follows [LEARN-LANGUAGES/CURRICULUM.md](../../CURRICULUM.md). Exercise ids are shared across LEARN-* repos for cross-reference.

## Testing

Stdout exercises stand in for a real unit harness.

exercises.title: Basic test (stdout)
exercises.description: Implement `sum` and print `sum(2, 3)` (same intent as the C `#[test]` exercise).

exercises.title: Table cases (stdout)
exercises.description: Print `6 0 -4` from `multiply` for the three pairs.
hints: Use `printf("%d %d %d", ...);` with no trailing newline if expected has none.

exercises.title: Divide and error (stdout)
exercises.description: Print `ok` if `divide(10,2)` is 5 and `divide(10,0)` is -1 (use -1 as error sentinel).

exercises.title: Error message check (stdout)
exercises.description: If `validate(-5)` returns a string containing `negative`, print `yes`.

exercises.title: Hot path loop (stdout)
exercises.description: Call `sum(2,3)` ten thousand times, then print `done`.
hints: Use a `for` loop with a large bound.
